heroHeadline: Israel Threatens to Resume Gaza War Unless Hamas Disarms; IDF Now Controls 59% of Gaza as Ceasefire Frays
heroSubtitle: Israeli officials on May 3, 2026 explicitly threatened to tear up the October 2025 ceasefire and restart full-scale military operations unless Hamas agrees to a five-stage disarmament roadmap within 281 days — as the death toll since the ceasefire reached 828. IDF forces have quietly expanded territorial control to 59% of Gaza by pushing the 'Yellow Line' westward. Flotilla activist Saif Abu Keshek appeared in Ashkelon court alleging torture; the majority of detained flotilla activists were released and arrived in the Netherlands on May 4 while two remain in Israeli custody. Netanyahu's government approved a 'national plan' on settler youth violence on May 4 that human rights groups called cosmetic — as settlers were documented torching a Palestinian home under IDF watch on May 2 and an IDF raid in Nablus Old City killed one Palestinian on May 3.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OCHA, IDF, Gaza Ministry of Health, B'Tselem, ICC, ICJ, Reuters, Al Jazeera, OHCHR, UNRWA, Euronews, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Yesh Din, Human Rights Watch, Save the Children, Amnesty International, The National, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are subject to ongoing verification. The conflict has persisted since Israeli independence on May 14, 1948.
